name: Tatsumi Shizuki
source:
Newly appointed PE Teacher and advisor to the Swimming Club.
Has good intuition and follows her gut most of the time.
Struggling to get results as the Swimming Club advisor.
Having many responsibilities on top of being a novice teacher is a source of stress to her.
